title: .claude/pv-context.json
description: File at the repo root (alongside the .claude/ folder) that gives context to every skill in the pv-* framework (pv-init, pv-internal-workflow, pv-new, pv-fix, pv-how, pv-do). It's the only thing that makes those skills generic instead of tied to a specific project. Created and updated by the pv-init skill; no other skill should write it from scratch. If the file exists but is incomplete, pv-init merges onto what's already there without overwriting anything. Any pv-* skill that needs a missing field should tell the user to run pv-init, not reimplement the bootstrap.

skillModels.description: OPTIONAL in this schema, but pv-init always writes it (mirroring each SKILL.md's real frontmatter via scripts/collect-skill-models.py, even if the user customizes nothing) so it's never left absent after init. Source of truth for which model/effort (Claude) each 'pv-*' skill in this repo runs with. The Claude Code harness only reads the 'model'/'effort' field from each SKILL.md's frontmatter -- not this JSON -- so this section has no effect on its own. After editing 'default' or 'overrides', run the sync script documented in '_instructions' to propagate the values to each SKILL.md's actual frontmatter.

_instructions.description: Reminder, in the file itself, of how to apply changes made to 'default'/'overrides'. No skill should delete this key.

default.description: Default model/effort for any 'pv-*' skill without its own entry in 'overrides'.

overrides.description: OPTIONAL. One entry per skill name (the 'name:' in its SKILL.md, e.g. 'pv-status') that needs a model/effort different from 'default'.

framework.description: Configuration that the pv-* skills understand and use directly (paths for the change-tracking process, language configuration).

workFolder.description: OPTIONAL (default '/', the repo root). Folder, relative to the repo root, under which the pv-* framework manages ALL of its work. Inside workFolder, the skills create two fixed-name subfolders by themselves -- '{workFolder}/changes/' and '{workFolder}/versions/' -- which the user doesn't choose or rename, to avoid any manual configuration that could break or collide with those paths. '{workFolder}/changes/' contains two subtrees with numbered subfolders ({xxxx}): 'changes/inProgress/' (changes/fixes documented by pv-new/pv-fix, pending implementation or planning) and 'changes/implemented/' (changes/fixes whose plan.md has already been implemented -- pv-do moves them there); the same {xxxx} must never repeat between the two. 'changes/todo/' (loose ideas from pv-todo, outside the change/fix flow) and 'changes/closed/' (changes/fixes already folded into a release, managed by pv-version/pv-internal-changelog) can also live there. '{workFolder}/versions/' contains one subfolder per release prepared with pv-version, with a free-text XXXX code chosen by the user on each invocation -- a numbering space entirely independent from changes/'s {xxxx}.

sourcecodeDir.description: OPTIONAL. Project's source code root folder (relative to the repo root). Used by pv-how as fallback context when analyzing a change/fix and writing its plan.md, only when docs.tech.architectureDocDir doesn't exist as a real folder in the repo.

interaction.description: OPTIONAL. Language the pv-* skills use to talk to the user in chat (questions, confirmations, summaries). Also the fallback value for changes.language, versions.language, and any docs.*.language block without its own language.

language.description: OPTIONAL (default 'en'). Free text or an ISO 639-1 code (e.g. 'es', 'fr').

changes.description: OPTIONAL. Language of the documents for an in-progress change/fix (description.md, plan.md, history.md, and the sample text in design_*.html/.txt mockups) under {workFolder}/changes/**.

language.description: OPTIONAL. Defaults to framework.interaction.language (or 'en' if that's also missing).

versions.description: OPTIONAL. Language of changelog.md, generated by pv-internal-changelog under {workFolder}/versions/{XXXX}/ from changes/closed.

language.description: OPTIONAL. Defaults to framework.interaction.language (or 'en' if that's also missing).

_comments.description: OPTIONAL. Informational metadata for whoever edits the JSON by hand (e.g. why each language was chosen). Ignored at runtime by the skills -- same pattern as skillModels._instructions.

skills.description: OPTIONAL. Swappable skills (Skill tool) that the rest of the framework invokes by name to delegate a specific responsibility, instead of hardcoding it into every skill that needs it. Swapping the name here is enough to change technology/notation without touching pv-new/pv-fix/pv-how/pv-internal-workflow, as long as the skill named here fulfills the same input/output contract as the one it replaces (documented in that skill's SKILL.md).

mockups.description: OPTIONAL (default 'pv-internal-mockups-html'). Name of the skill that pv-new and pv-fix invoke to create/edit a change/fix's 'design_*.html' mockups, only once it's already known that at least one is needed. No need to ask about it or configure it unless the user wants to replace HTML mockup generation with another technology (Figma, a component library, images...): in that case, the skill named here must fulfill the same input/output contract documented in pv-internal-mockups-html/SKILL.md (destination folder + list of elements to create/edit as input; paths of the resulting files as output) so it can be swapped in without touching pv-new/pv-fix.

diagrams.description: OPTIONAL (default 'pv-internal-tech-mermaid'). Name of the skill that pv-internal-workflow, pv-new, pv-fix and pv-how invoke to generate a change/fix's Mermaid diagrams (functional or technical -- flow, sequence), only once it's already known that at least one is needed. No need to ask about it or configure it unless the user wants to replace Mermaid diagram generation with another notation or tool: in that case, the skill named here must fulfill the same input/output contract documented in pv-internal-tech-mermaid/SKILL.md (list of diagrams to generate, with type and what each should represent, as input; each diagram's code as output) so it can be swapped in without touching pv-internal-workflow/pv-new/pv-fix/pv-how.

numberWidth.description: OPTIONAL (default 5). Number of digits of the sequential 'xxxx' code, zero-padded. Always written to pv-context.json even when the default is used -- the scripts that consume it have no fallback of their own. No need to ask the user unless they want something different from the default.

docs.description: OPTIONAL. External reference documentation for the project, grouped by area ('functional', 'tech').

functional.description: OPTIONAL. Functional documentation that the pv-* skills use as context and keep in sync.

featuresDocPathDir.description: OPTIONAL. Listing of features already implemented in the project (relative to the repo root). Can be a FOLDER (recommended, e.g. 'design/docs/features') with one file per feature plus a generated 'INDEX.md' -- in that case pv-do delegates reading/writing to the pv-internal-doc-features skill, which knows that convention -- or, in older projects that haven't migrated yet, a single .md file. pv-do adds or updates the corresponding entry there every time it implements a change/fix, creating the folder/file if it doesn't exist yet. If not configured, this step is skipped without asking anything.

language.description: OPTIONAL. Language of featuresDocPathDir. Defaults to framework.interaction.language (or 'en' if that's also missing).

tech.description: OPTIONAL. Technical documentation that the pv-* skills use as context and keep in sync.

architectureDocDir.description: OPTIONAL. Folder (relative to the repo root) with the architecture/technical-design document, split into several files for selective reading by an LLM. Must contain an 'INDEX.md' summarizing what each sibling file covers (with a 2-digit numeric prefix, e.g. '01-', '02-'). pv-do keeps this folder in sync after implementing each change/fix, creating a new file with the next free number if the topic doesn't fit any existing one. If not configured, this step is skipped without asking anything.

styleBibleDocDir.description: OPTIONAL. Folder (relative to the repo root) with the project's style guide (visual, interaction, writing), split into several files for selective reading by an LLM. Must contain an 'INDEX.md' summarizing what each sibling file covers (with a 2-digit numeric prefix, e.g. '01-', '02-'). pv-do keeps this folder in sync after implementing each change/fix, creating a new file with the next free number if the topic doesn't fit any existing one. If not configured, this step is skipped without asking anything.

language.description: OPTIONAL. Language shared by architectureDocDir and styleBibleDocDir. Defaults to framework.interaction.language (or 'en' if that's also missing).

model.description: Value accepted by a SKILL.md frontmatter's 'model' field (the same IDs accepted by /model, e.g. 'claude-sonnet-5', 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001', or 'inherit').

effort.description: Value accepted by a SKILL.md frontmatter's 'effort' field.

skillModels._instructions: After editing 'default'/'overrides', run from the repo root: python .claude/skills/pv-init/scripts/sync-skill-models.py -- rewrites 'model'/'effort' in every 'pv-*' SKILL.md's frontmatter according to this section.

_comments.interaction.language: Chat with the user in English.
_comments.changes.language: The team documents each in-progress change/fix in Spanish.
_comments.versions.language: The published changelog is written in Spanish.
_comments.docs.tech.language: Architecture and style bible in English, to share with external collaborators.
